}}'''Spiritualism''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Grow Forest]] ability, which turns a field [[Terrain|tile]] into a forest tile at a cost of 5 [[stars]], and the [[Temples|Forest Temple]], which costs 15 stars (5 stars less than other temples).
